name: GeoGuessr Helper
description: Displays location information (coordinates, map, region name) for the current GeoGuessr round to help you learn geography.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https://flagcdn.com https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com;
